duration.text: The Regional Economics at Chongqing Normal University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2638 USD/per year ￥ 19000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 3. Transcript of undergraduate school 4. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 5. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: Applicants should have a bachelor degree or above with HSK Grade 3 Certificate or new HSK Band 4 certificate. For those who haven't HSK certificate but with equivalent Chinese proficiency by School evaluation, you could apply to enter study in programs but must achieve the HSK certificate in one year.
